name: Ironband's Excavation
summary: Jern Hornhelm has sent you from Thelsamar to find out why Ironband's Excavation is making so little progress. Supplies reach Prospector Ironband's team, and Jern trusts his diligence, but the work remains slow.

sections.title: A Slowdown in the Foothills
sections.body: Jern Hornhelm watches from Thelsamar as provisions and tools cross Loch Modan to the Explorers' League. They arrive steadily, yet the dig makes little progress. Jern suspects something is disrupting the work. He needs you to find out what is holding the team back.

sections.title: The Trogg Infestation
sections.body: At the excavation in the eastern hills, Explorer Magmar Fellhew reports that violent troggs have overrun the site. They harass the dwarven crew and scatter its discoveries. Until the intruders are driven back, the League cannot study the ancient stones.

faq.q: Who sends you to Ironband's Excavation?
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar asks you to check on the excavation. Deliveries continue, but progress remains slow, and he wants you to learn why.

faq.q: Where is the excavation site located?
faq.answer: The excavation lies in the foothills east of the loch. From Thelsamar, skirt the southern end of the water, then follow the path east into the hills.
Magmar Fellhew is an explorer assisting Prospector Ironband at the dig. He oversees its daily work and logistics, and explains the situation to messengers from Thelsamar.

faq.q: Why has progress stalled at the dig?
faq.answer: Aggressive troggs have halted the expedition. They surged into the ruins, disrupted the excavation, and forced the League to defend itself.

faq.q: What comes next after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Magmar Fellhew directs you to help the team reclaim what was lost. The work continues with Gathering Idols, as you recover relics stolen by the troggs.

faq.q: What is the Explorers' League looking for here?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband's expedition seeks ancient relics and stonework beneath Loch Modan. The discoveries may shed light on dwarven history and their long-lost origins.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know each dig in Khaz Modan helps reveal the truth of dwarven ancestry and Titan heritage. Ironforge depends on Ironband's crew staying safe.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Loch Modan by keeping its trade roads and research sites clear of trogg tribes from below.
